import pandas as pd
p=pd.read_csv('data/patients.csv.gz'); a=pd.read_csv('data/admissions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['admit_time','discharge_time']); l=pd.read_csv('data/labs.csv.gz',parse_dates=['collect_time','report_time'])
g=a.groupby('patient_id').admit_time.agg(['min','max','count']); g['span_y']=(g['max']-g['min']).dt.days/365.25
print(g[g['count']>1].span_y.describe())
m=g.join(p.set_index('patient_id')); print('age<=20 with span:', ((m.age-m.span_y)<18).sum())
print('multi-adm patients without family', m[(m['count']>1)&m.family_id.isna()].shape[0])
l=l.merge(a[['admission_id','admit_time','discharge_time','unit','discharge_status']],on='admission_id')
l['h']=(l.collect_time-l.admit_time).dt.total_seconds()/3600
print('labs before admit',(l.h<0).sum(),'after discharge',(l.collect_time>l.discharge_time).sum())
cr=l[l.test=='creatinine']; cr['day']=(cr.h//24).clip(upper=7)
t=cr.groupby(['unit','day']).size()/a.unit.value_counts(); print(cr.groupby(['unit','day']).size().unstack(0))
# per-admission daily frequency normalized by admissions alive that day
for u in ['ICU','ward']:
  aa=a[a.unit==u]; 
  print(u,[round(len(cr[(cr.unit==u)&(cr.day==d)])/max(1,((aa.discharge_time-aa.admit_time).dt.total_seconds()/3600>d*24).sum()),2) for d in range(7)])
print(pd.crosstab(a.unit,a.discharge_status,normalize='index'))
"
